deep_dive.executive_summary: Cadiz owns permitted Mojave groundwater storage and a 220-mile pipeline path, plus ATEC filter sales ($16.3 million FY2025 revenue). The company still loses money ($31.1 million net FY2025) and carries $78.3 million of debt while raising ~$451 million through project vehicle MWI (Lytton $51 million facility signed October 2025). We expect 6.2% per year over seven years to a $6.00 per share payoff if partial financing and pipeline conversion proceed. Dhando is partial; moat unproven. Stance watch until binding MWI equity and an in-service date.
